official.description_text:
Postdoc in Large Language Model inferencing
Login and apply
KTH Royal Institute of Technology, School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
Job description
The advertised post-doctoral position is within an ambitious, 5-year Wallenberg Scholar project titled "Scalable and adaptive inferencing for democratizing AI". In this 18 Million SEK project, we want to dramatically reduce the cost and power for serving large language models such as ChatGPT.
More project information
and our
project page
with early publications.
The work will primarily entail design, implementation, and evaluation of distributed systems and networks for machine learning inference. Applying machine learning concepts, with the goal of devising agentic frameworks, will also be a part of the project.
As a member of the research lab, you will be involved in experimental systems work in collaboration with faculty members and several doctoral students at our research lab. You will contribute to scientific publications as well as to new grant applications.
The work will be in collaboration with Professor Dejan Kostic and Associate Professor Marco Chiesa.
Qualifications
Requirements
A doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign degree. This eligibility requirement must be met no later than the time the employment decision is made.
You should also have a solid background in distributed systems, networking, programming and operating systems, and very good knowledge of English in speech and writing as it is required in day to day work.
It is important that you have very good skills in critical thinking and very good knowledge of C++, Python, Linux, and some scripting language.
We are seeking a highly motivated candidate with a willingness to experiment and explore, with international publications in journals and top conferences.
Preferred qualifications
A doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign degree, obtained within the last three years prior to the application deadline
Teaching abilities and awareness of diversity and equal opportunity issues, with specific focus on gender equality.
You are a good collaborator but can also work independently.
Experience with machine learning, GPU programming, or large-scale inference systems.
Awareness of diversity and equal opportunity issues, with specific focus on gender equality
Great emphasis will be placed on personal skills.
Join us at KTH
KTH shapes the future through education, research and innovation. As a leading international technical university, we play an active role in advancing the transition towards a sustainable society. At KTH, you have the opportunity to grow and develop in a creative and dynamic environment, with good working conditions and attractive benefits. Equality, diversity and equal opportunities are essential to quality and form an integral part of KTH’s core values as a university and public authority.
Learn more about our benefits and what it's like to work and grow at KTH.
Trade union representatives
Contact information to
trade union representatives.
To apply for the position
Log into KTH's recruitment system to apply for this position. You are responsible for ensuring that your application is complete according to the instructions in the ad.
The application must include:
CV including relevant professional experience and knowledge.
Copy of diplomas and grades from your previous university studies. Translations into English or Swedish if the original documents have not been issued in any of these languages.
Brief account of why you want to conduct research, your academic interests and how they relate to your previous studies and future goals. Maximally two pages long.
Your complete application must be received at KTH no later than the last day of application, midnight CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time).
About the employment
The position offered is for, at the most, two years.
A
position as a postdoctoral fellow
is a time-limited qualified appointment focusing mainly on research, intended as a first career step after a dissertation.
Other information
For

If this applies to the specific position, a security clearance will be conducted for the applicant in accordance with the same law with the applicant's consent. In such cases, a prerequisite for employment is that the applicant is approved following the security clearance.
We firmly decline all contact with staffing and recruitment agencies and job ad salespersons.

ai.summary: 18 Million SEK, 5-year Wallenberg Scholar project at KTH Stockholm. Postdoc position focuses on design, implementation, and evaluation of distributed systems for machine learning inference, cost/power reduction for LLM serving, with machine learning and agentic frameworks components. Requires distributed systems, networking, programming, OS expertise.

thematic_fit.rationale: Position is pure systems and machine learning infrastructure work: distributed ML inference, network optimization, LLM serving cost reduction. No mention of human-centered research, immersive systems, spatial cognition, collaboration, learning outcomes, or user evaluation. Thematic core is orthogonal to researcher's target identity. Even 'agentic frameworks' reference suggests AI system design, not human-agent collaboration in immersive contexts.

methodological_fit.rationale: Minimal overlap. Position demands 'very good skills in critical thinking and very good knowledge of C++, Python, Linux' and systems-experimental work on inference optimization. Researcher has beginner Python, no C++, no systems programming background, no GPU/distributed systems experience. The 'experimental systems work' methodology differs markedly from user-centered empirical research. No transferable methods.

growth_value.rationale: This position would not close gaps relevant to the researcher's target trajectory. Python beginner skills might develop, but the researcher would be learning low-level systems and GPU optimization—excluded directions per target profile (gpu-optimisation explicitly listed). No advancement toward human-centered immersive systems, spatial cognition, or collaborative learning research.

strategic_value.rationale: KTH is a strong institution in the preferred country (Sweden). Wallenberg Scholar funding is prestigious and stable. However, the research group is focused on ML systems infrastructure, not HCI or immersive systems. Supervisor expertise (Kostic: distributed systems, Chiesa: networking) does not align with human-centered or immersive research goals. Position does not advance stated career identity or institutional proximity to target groups.

eligibility_flags: Position explicitly requires 'very good knowledge of C++'; researcher has none.
Posting mentions possible security clearance under Swedish Protective Security Act (2018:585). Ambiguity on whether this role triggers clearance; researcher should clarify.

Preferred qualification specifies PhD obtained within last 3 years. If researcher completes MSc→PhD within typical timeline (3–4 years), she may fall outside this window. Timing contingent on PhD completion date.
risks: Severe skills gap: C++, distributed systems, GPU programming, Linux systems not in profile. Ramp-up time would be substantial.
Excluded direction: GPU optimization is explicitly listed as an excluded research area in target profile.
Thematic misalignment: pure ML systems infrastructure has no connection to human-centered immersive systems, spatial learning, or collaboration research.
Career direction risk: accepting this position would lock the researcher into a systems/ML track inconsistent with stated goal to become a human-centered XR/HCI researcher.
